items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of Erstausstattung
items.quote: Ein Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid ist binnen eines Monats nach dessen Bekanntgabe zulässig.
items.computation: Bescheid dated Friday 10.04.2026. Under §37 Abs. 2 SGB X a letter sent by post is deemed delivered (bekanntgegeben) on the third day after mailing, i.e. 13.04.2026 (Monday, no holiday in Hessen). Under §187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the triggering event (13.04.) is excluded, so the one-month Widerspruchsfrist begins on 14.04.2026. Under §188 Abs. 2 BGB a period expressed in months ends on the day of the last month bearing the same number as the day the period started counting from (13), i.e. 13.05.2026 (Wednesday). 13.05.2026 is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in Hessen (Ascension Day falls on 14.05.2026), so the deadline is not shifted.
